messages.board.title: Claude Agent
messages.agents.title: Agents
messages.consent.title: Install Claude Agent SDK
messages.consent.body: This board downloads @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.302 from registry.npmjs.org after you accept. Use is subject to Anthropic's legal agreements. The installed claude CLI and its existing login are required. The SDK is stored in your Persephone user data, not in this board.
messages.cli.required: Install the claude CLI and sign in with its normal login before starting a session.
messages.permissions: Trust grants this board a background service and App scripting. Sessions started here run without permission prompts: Claude can edit files, run commands, and fully control Persephone through its private MCP endpoint.
messages.settings: Provider settings are managed in Settings → Editors → Claude Agent.
messages.startHint: Choose a working directory, then type your first message below to start the session.
messages.consentRequired: Accept the SDK download before starting a Claude session.
messages.resizeSidebar: Drag to resize · double-click to reset
messages.sessionIdle: Not running. Sending a message resumes it here.
messages.sessionWorking: Running on this board. Claude is working.
messages.instructionsNote: Added to Claude's system prompt, after a generated line with the working directory and whether Persephone MCP is attached. Saved changes apply to sessions you start or reopen afterwards; a connected session keeps the instructions it started with.
messages.deleteConfirm: Delete “{title}”? Its stored transcript is removed from disk and cannot be restored.
messages.noLiveSession: Choose a working directory or a session first.
messages.controlTimeout: The session did not answer in time.
messages.cmd.mcp: Manage MCP servers: status, reconnect, enable or disable, authenticate
messages.cmd.model: Switch the model (and effort) for this session
messages.cmd.effort: Set the effort level for this session
messages.cmd.context: Show what fills the context window
messages.cmd.clear: Start a new session in the same folder
messages.mcpNone: No MCP servers are configured for this session.
messages.mcpAuthOpened: Opened the sign-in page for {server}. Finish there, then press Reconnect.
messages.effortHint: Effort changes run as an /effort command in the chat.
messages.effortBusy: Wait for the current turn to finish before changing effort.
messages.deferred: Deferred: loaded only when Claude uses it
messages.contextNeedsSession: Open or start a session to see its context usage.
